verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a passing mention that self-hosted LangSmith covers 'prompt engineering', linking to a prompt hub page, plus a Playground service for sending requests to LLMs. This suggests first-party prompt management exists, but nothing in the pack documents prompt versioning or promoting prompt changes to production without a code deploy. Missing for 10: documented prompt versioning/commits, environment tags or promotion of prompt versions, runtime prompt fetching via SDK so changes ship without code, independent or hands-on corroboration.
